title: Finite direct image does not change etale cohomology (edge map)
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with direct image $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and counit $\varepsilon_{f,F}:f^{-1}f_*F\to F$ of the adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For $q\ge0$ define the *edge map* $$e^q_{f,F}=H^q(\varepsilon_{f,F})\circ f^*:\ H^q(Y_{\Et},f_*F)\xrightarrow{\ f^*\ }H^q(X_{\Et},f^{-1}f_*F)\xrightarrow{\ H^q(\varepsilon_{f,F})\ }H^q(X_{\Et},F),$$ where $f^*$ is the pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] and $H^q(\varepsilon_{f,F})$ the map induced on the cohomology groups of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] by a morphism of sheaves, as in [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. Then $e^q_{f,F}$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$. (In degree $0$ it is the identity of $\Gamma(Y,f_*F)=F(X\times_YY)=\Gamma(X,F)$.)

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section 03SB, proof of Lemma 0A5D (lemma-finite-pushforward-statements): 'H^q(X,F)=H^q(Y,f_*F) by the vanishing of R^qf_* for q>0 (Proposition 03QP, proposition-finite-higher-direct-image-zero) and the Leray spectral sequence (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 0733, sites-cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray)'; the same identification in the proof of Lemma 0A5E (lemma-restrict-to-open) for a closed immersion. Intended proof: f_* is exact (lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact) and preserves injectives (lem-weil-pbc-direct-image-preserves-injectives), so f_* of an injective resolution of F is an injective resolution of f_*F with the same global sections.
